title: OmniRoute Delegation Task Schema
description: Schema for validating delegation task payloads sent to the OmniRoute MCP gateway. This schema defines the structure of the 'tarefa' parameter for the 'delegar_tarefa' tool.

tarefa.description: The self-contained task description. Must include: Objetivo, Restrições, Contexto, Formato esperado, Critérios de sucesso.

perfil.description: Profile/route hint for model selection. Must be confirmed against runtime schema before use. Known observed values: cheap, fast, coding, coding:pro, smart.

contexto.description: Additional context to be sent alongside the task. Treated as untrusted data by the leaf agent.

task_id.description: Tracking identifier for the delegation. Do not assume idempotency or deduplication without querying the cache.

session_id.description: Application-level session identifier. Only use when present in the current tool schema and when delegation continuity is required. Do not confuse with mcp-session-id.

cache_mode.description: Cache strategy: 'native' for normal delegations, 'bypass' for state-dependent responses, 'deterministic' only for equivalent repeatable tasks.

cache_key.description: Deterministic cache key representing ALL semantic elements (code, profile, version, parameters). Required when cache_mode is 'deterministic'.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens for the leaf response. Should be proportional to the expected output size.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Use 0 for deterministic responses.
